text: Heavy rain floods SIPCOT industrial estate in Hosur; several units halted, water expected to recede in 4-5 days.
IMD red alert: extremely heavy rainfall likely over Chennai and Kancheepuram districts for the next 72 hours.
Fire breaks out at Pune Magnetics plant in Chakan; production suspended indefinitely.
Transporters announce statewide strike across Tamil Nadu from Monday for 3 days over toll hike.
Scheduled power shutdown in Tumakuru industrial area on Thursday for maintenance, 8 hours.
India beat Australia by 6 wickets in Bengaluru T20 thriller.
Sensex closes 300 points higher as IT stocks rally.
Hosur Precision Castings: furnace breakdown, casting line down for 3 days.
Workers at Coimbatore Copper Drawing go on strike demanding wage revision; talks fail.
Landslide on Hosur-Krishnagiri highway; trucks diverted, delays of up to 2 days expected.
Bengaluru traffic police announce diversions for marathon on Sunday morning.
IMD: light to moderate rain likely over Mysuru district, no warnings issued.
Cyclone expected to make landfall near Chennai; ports at Ennore and Chennai to suspend operations for 2 days.
Explosion at Madurai Steel Frames paint shop; no casualties, unit closed for inspection for a week.
Manesar industrial belt hit by 10-hour power outage after grid failure.
Chennai Cell Imports says a shipment of Li-ion cells is held at port due to a customs clearance backlog; delay of 6 days.
Lorry owners withdraw their strike after talks; goods movement across Tamil Nadu back to normal.
Overnight downpour leaves Peenya industrial area knee-deep in water; most units shut for two days.
Fishermen's protest blocks Madras port gates; container movement halted for 36 hours.
Grid failure: Coimbatore industrial units without electricity for 48 hrs.
Fire at Madurai Steel Frames' warehouse; operations expected to resume after a fortnight.
Lockout declared at Tumakuru Wiring Pvt Ltd; management says the plant will stay shut for three days.
IMD withdraws orange alert for Chennai as the cyclone weakens; no disruption expected.
Centre imposes a 15% safeguard levy on imported lithium-ion cells.
Waterlogging at Oragadam and Kanchipuram after overnight rain; auto units shut for a day.
Fire safety mock drill at Hosur SIPCOT on Friday; no impact on production.
